item.title: Watch Live: Second psychiatric nurse practitioner testifies at Lindsay Clancy trial
item.description: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy in Massachusetts resumed Tuesday with testimony from a second psychiatric nurse who treated her.

item.title: Social Security adds 14 conditions to fast-track disability list
item.description: The Social Security Administration is expanding its list of conditions that may qualify for expedited disability approval.

item.title: Former US Marine Robert Gilman released after years of detention in Russia
item.description: Robert Gilman, a U.S. citizen and former Marine, has been freed from detention in Russia on humanitarian grounds, according to a State Department spokesperson.

item.title: What to know about Wednesday's total solar eclipse
item.description: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 will cross the Northern Hemisphere on Wednesday, Aug. 12, with totality visible in parts of Greenland and Iceland.
